name: Torrey & The Vampire
source:
When Torrey's best friend insists that the gorgeous guy living in the upscale mansion is a Vampire, she simply had to go see for herself.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/torreyvampire.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
托里最好的朋友坚称，住在豪华宅邸里的俊美男子是吸血鬼。托里实在按捺不住，只好亲自前去一探究竟。

[摘自[url=http://renai.us/game/torreyvampire.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
